purpose: Use one same-canonical hourly RRULE as bounded cold rescue and completion-relative continuation; predictive prearm remains rolled back until successor-start latency is understood.
canonical_invariant: Never create a replacement canonical merely to continue this actor. Mutate only the verified canonical identified by fresh durable state.

provisional_arm.when: Immediately after minimum stale-wake/fence/authority validation and before full restore or substantive work.
provisional_arm.reason: If the active turn dies before normal close, the same canonical retains a bounded cold-rescue opportunity.
provisional_arm.mutation_failure: Retry once when safe. If an older verified future continuation remains alive, enter DEGRADED_CONTINUATION and continue only within its safety envelope; otherwise fail closed before substantive side effects.

work.rule: Perform sustained useful authorized work. Ten minutes is the bounded planning target.
work.checkpoint_rule: Persist enough durable progress that a cold successor can resume without chat context.
work.collision_rule: If useful work remains and provisional due approaches too closely, extend the provisional DTSTART before collision, then verify.

normal_final_rearm.due: actual observed normal-close timestamp + 60 seconds, preserving seconds exactly; minute rounding is forbidden
normal_final_rearm.precision_rule: Pass local_dtstart with YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS under the canonical timezone. Do not truncate or round seconds.

predictive_prearm_canary.reentry_condition: Do not repeat until UTIL-EXP-019 produces new evidence explaining or materially reducing successor observation/claim-to-first-useful delay.
predictive_prearm_canary.safety_rule: Any future retry still requires fresh authority fencing and no duplicate substantive side effects.

successor_start_measurement.rule: Do not infer missing boundaries. Attribute delay to the measured segment before changing scheduler timing again.
successor_start_measurement.latest_finding: Observed predecessor end-to-due=134s dominated the valid sample; exact-second completion-relative rearm is the next correction.

evidence_basis.observed_sequence: Stage 1 woke, mutated the same canonical hourly RRULE DTSTART to actual wake +2m, persisted Stage 2 prompt, then Stage 2 executed and the same canary was disabled.

rollback: Preserve the canonical and completion-relative fallback whenever an experimental cadence produces unsafe overlap, missed continuation, rollback, or an out-of-budget useful-work handoff.
